purpose: v12 compact staging with request/prefill cache release

runs.note: Native learned ceil/threshold ties UNION recent-20; current input KV always computed locally. Prefill is Full. V12 staging starts at ceil(max_length * ratio) + recent, grows without truncating ties. Async carries unpublished newest history from GPU. Request-boundary empty_cache precedes timing; post-prefill empty_cache is included. Timing includes selection, host packing and real copies; GPU event intervals under concurrency are elapsed stream intervals, not isolated service time.

interpretation: Prefill, decode and end-to-end are separate. decode_tokens_per_s excludes prefill. Peak GPU allocation and physical pinned CPU/GPU staging are reported separately.

nvml_memory.scope: NVML whole-device used memory, sampled from model loading through warmup and measured runs; includes CUDA context/non-PyTorch allocations. Not an exact instantaneous peak. GPU exclusively assigned; no other process modified.
